title: Pale Overgrowth
description: A Small Mod adding new foliage to the Pale Garden
body:
Pale Overgrowth is a small mod made for Halloween thats adds new foliage to the Pale Garden


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


# Pale Pumpkins

![A Picture of Pale Pumpkins](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2fc5b0393c51b36c66a46214d5207f79ca26cc74_0.webp)

a New varient of pumpkins which can be grown and carved, if carved and worn on a players head it will hide their nametag, these can also be made into Pale Jack o'Lanterns


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


# Blooming Pale Trees

![A Blooming Pale Tree](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e14b35947ba32e8aedc7caa73fccdcbb40a0146.png)

Occasionally around the pale garden you may find a Blooming Pale tree these trees can be distinguished by the Flowers on their leaves and the Gaze Berries hanging from them
